item.title: Konsoll 3.7.1-beta.14
item.description:
## What's new (beta)
The stable release is still 3.7.0.

Only the files come along: agents and command blocks still need zsh or bash on the host. - **⌘-click on remote output that opens nothing says why**: the host's shell is not one Konsoll sets up, it is not reporting its folder, the host wants a password, the file does not exist or is still being checked, the connection has closed, or the file can only be dragged to the Finder.

item.title: Konsoll 3.7.1-beta.9
item.description:
## What's new (beta)
The stable release is still 3.7.0.
### Added
- **Neovim (Konsoll): Neovim as a Mac app.** Konsoll now carries a second app with its own name and icon in the Dock. It opens each file or folder in a window of its own running `nvim`, with no tabs, splits or shell, like Neovide or neovim-qt, and uses Konsoll's font, colors and transparency. - Right-click a file or folder ▸ **Open With ▸ Neovim (Konsoll)**, drop it on the Dock icon, or run `open -a "Neovim (Konsoll)" file.txt`. Konsoll offers it in Open With once it has been opened. - **File ▸ Use as Default Editor for Text Files** makes it the default for about a hundred text types at once, without a confirmation per type: plain text, source code in most languages, scripts, configuration, JSON, YAML, TOML, Markdown, CSV, logs… The change takes a few seconds. - Closing a window, or quitting, asks nvim to quit (`:confirm qa`), so it asks about unsaved buffers. Closing again within 3 seconds offers to end it. - `nvim` is found through your login shell's `PATH`, Homebrew's included; without it, the window says how to install it. - **Files over SSH by dragging.** Drop files or folders from the Finder on an SSH session to upload them into the remote shell's current directory. **⌘-drag** a file or folder named in the output (`ls`, `find`, a path) to the Finder to download it; local files drag out the same way. - Transfers use one connection of Konsoll's own per session, opened the way you typed `ssh`: you sign in once, and it closes with the session or after ten idle minutes. - A password, passphrase or new host key is asked in a native dialog and never stored.
### Changed
- ⌘-click opens a link when the button is released, so that ⌘-drag can drag it instead. - On a host that asks for a password, holding ⌘ over its output hints at signing in, and ⌘-click signs in so that its files become links.
### Fixed
- Password prompts for SSH transfers failed as if cancelled. - A slow host no longer makes file links blink out or hold up the others.
### Since 3.7.1-beta.1
- File paths in the output are links, ⌥-click enters a folder, and ⌘ over an image previews it — see the 3.7.1-beta.8 notes. - **New Tab** and **New Window** in the Dock icon's menu — see the 3.7.1-beta.7 notes. - **Shell ▸ New Agent in Worktree…** is listed only while the current pane is in a git repository on this Mac — see the 3.7.1-beta.5 and 3.7.1-beta.6 notes. - Open Konsoll at a folder from the Finder — see the 3.7.1-beta.4 notes.
Please report a text file type that Neovim (Konsoll) does not open, or a transfer that fails.

item.title: Konsoll 3.7.1-beta.8
item.description:
## What's new (beta)
The stable release is still 3.7.0.
### Added
- **File paths in the output are links.** Hold ⌘ and click a path that a command printed — `docs/RELEASE.md`, a name from `ls`, a result from `find` or `grep` — to open it. Relative paths open from the folder the command ran in, even after you `cd` elsewhere. `src/main.cpp:42:7` (grep, compilers) opens your editor at that line. - **Settings ▸ Terminal ▸ Open text files with**: the editor that ⌘-clicked files open in, such as `code -g {file}:{line}:{column}`, or a terminal editor (`nvim +{line} {file}`) in a new tab. Empty: each file's default app. - **⌥-click a folder** in the output to `cd` into it, when the shell waits at an empty prompt. Holding ⌥ underlines the folders you can enter. - **Image previews**: hold ⌘ over an image, PDF or video file in the output and a preview appears beside the pointer.
### Changed
- Opening a link never runs anything: apps and installers are only shown in the Finder, and scripts open as text. - Paths are not linked in ssh sessions or on network volumes, which are never touched. - `OSC 8` file links with this Mac's name (`rg --hyperlink-format=default`, `ls --hyperlink`) open now.
### Fixed
- zsh and bash reported the working directory with a stray `%23` before the path.
### Since 3.7.1-beta.1
- **New Tab** and **New Window** in the Dock icon's menu — see the 3.7.1-beta.7 notes. - **Shell ▸ New Agent in Worktree…** is listed only while the current pane is in a git repository on this Mac — see the 3.7.1-beta.5 and 3.7.1-beta.6 notes. - Open Konsoll at a folder from the Finder — see the 3.7.1-beta.4 notes.
Please report a path that should be a link and is not, or one that opens the wrong file.

item.title: Konsoll 3.7.1-beta.4
item.description:
## What's new (beta)
The stable release is still 3.7.0. This beta adds opening Konsoll at a folder from the Finder, on top of the changes in 3.7.1-beta.3.
### Added
- **Open Konsoll at a folder from the Finder.** Right-click a folder and choose **New Konsoll Tab Here** or **New Konsoll Window Here** (under *Services* or *Quick Actions* when the menu is long). They also work on a path selected as text in any app. Dropping a folder on Konsoll's Dock icon, or `open -a Konsoll ~/some/folder`, opens a tab there. When Konsoll wasn't running, the folder takes the place of the tab it opens at launch.
If the items don't show up, open Konsoll once after updating, then turn them on in **System Settings ▸ Keyboard ▸ Keyboard Shortcuts… ▸ Services ▸ Files and Folders**, where you can also give them a keyboard shortcut. The README has the details ([Opening Konsoll from the Finder](https://github.com/rask-project/Konsoll#opening-konsoll-from-the-finder)).
### Changed (since 3.7.1-beta.1)
- Images (kitty graphics, sixel, iTerm2 inline images) are kept in one place only. The renderer takes the pixels from there when it draws them. - An agent whose pane closes while `read_pane` waits for your answer gets its "Your pane was closed" reply from the closing pane itself.
Please report a Finder item that is missing or opens the wrong folder, and anything odd with images or agents reading a pane.

item.title: Konsoll 3.7.1-beta.3
item.description:
## What's new (beta)
The same changes as 3.7.1-beta.1, published again so that it reaches everyone in the beta channel. The stable release is still 3.7.0. There was no public beta.2.
### Changed
- Images (kitty graphics, sixel, iTerm2 inline images) are kept in one place only. The renderer takes the pixels from there when it draws them, instead of holding its own reference to every image on screen. - An agent whose pane closes while `read_pane` waits for your answer now gets its "Your pane was closed" reply from the closing pane itself.
Please report images that flicker, go missing or show stale frames (animations included), and anything odd with agents asking to read a pane.

item.title: Konsoll 3.7.0
item.description:
## What's new
3.7.0 keeps Konsoll up to date by itself.
### Updates
- **Automatic updates.** Once a day Konsoll looks for a newer release, downloads it in the background and installs it when you quit. Updates are signed, and they open without clearing the quarantine flag. - **Konsoll ▸ Check for Updates…** checks right away, shows what changed and offers to install and relaunch. - **Settings ▸ Updates** turns the automatic checks and downloads off and picks the channel: **Stable only** (the default) or **Stable and beta**, which also offers pre-releases for testing.
This is the last version to install by hand: from here on, Konsoll updates itself.
